crossRefs.note: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
“Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for…
We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were…
Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while…
Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I…
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because…

translations.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
translations.bsb: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.
translations.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
translations.asv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.
